learning_outcomes.text: Evaluate the societal role of the professional engineer.
Conduct a case study investigating the causes and potential mitigation factors for a chosen high profile engineering disaster.
Safely conduct machining, fabrication and assembly operations in an appropriate workshop environment.
Communicate the technical specification of individual machined components and assemblies.
Communicate the findings of experimental work to a wide audience of technical and non-technical stakeholders.

syllabus_topics: plagiarism and appropriate use of generative AI
workshop based machining and assembly skills

assessment_methods.method: Professional Practice Portfolio (Engineering Disaster Case Study, Professional Practice Canvas Assessment)
Design and Practical Skills Portfolio (Offsite workshop practice training, CAD and technical drawings, Lab workbooks)
